_readme: All site copy lives here. Edit and run `node build.mjs`. Structure mirrors the reference site: numbered sections 01-06 down a left spine, alternating dark and light.

meta.title: Infinity Development — IT solutions, software, cloud and AI
meta.description: An IT company covering the full spectrum: server software, cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, web development, IoT and UI/UX design. One team, one contract.

hero.headline: Build once. Scale without limits
hero.body: Infinity Development is an IT company covering the complete spectrum of a modern build: server software solutions, cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, web development, Internet of Things and UI/UX design — delivered by one engineering team, under one contract.
hero.photo: Wide shot of the team at work — open-plan office, screens lit, shallow depth of field. Dark enough to carry white type across the upper half.

services.label: Our services
services.headline: Turning requirements into working systems
services.intro: We build and run the software businesses depend on. One team across the whole stack — from the database schema to the brand that sits on top of it.

items.title: Custom Software Development
items.body: Bespoke systems designed around how your business actually operates — internal platforms, integrations and the APIs that hold them together.
items.photo: Close crop of hands on a keyboard, warm desk light, code out of focus behind.

items.title: Cloud Solutions & Services
items.body: Architecture, migration and the part that comes after: scaling, cost control, backups and uptime you do not have to think about.
items.photo: Data centre corridor, racks receding, cool blue-green lighting.

items.title: Cybersecurity & Risk Management
items.body: Hardening, access control, monitoring and audit built into the system from the start rather than bolted on after an incident.
items.photo: Macro of a circuit board, teal traces catching the light.

items.title: AI Integration & Machine Learning
items.body: Models and data pipelines pointed at specific work — document handling, forecasting, classification, triage. Applied where it pays.
items.photo: Abstract neural or particle visual, teal on black.

items.title: IT Support & Managed Services
items.body: Proactive technical support and system care that keeps operations stable, patched and monitored around the clock.
items.photo: Operations desk, multiple monitors with dashboards, engineer silhouetted.

items.title: Built Around You
items.body: Every system is designed against how your business runs today and where it is going, not against a template.

items.title: Current by Design
items.body: Modern tooling chosen for longevity and support, never for novelty. What we build stays maintainable.

items.title: One Accountable Team
items.body: The people who scope the work are the people who build it. No subcontracting chain, no handover gaps.

items.title: Security You Can Trust
items.body: Access control, encryption, monitoring and audit trails designed in from the first sprint.

items.title: Seamless Integration
items.body: New technology introduced alongside what you already run, without stopping the business to do it.

items.title: Cloud Optimisation
items.body: Infrastructure sized deliberately — you pay for the capacity you use, not the capacity someone guessed at.

items.title: Agile Delivery
items.body: Working software every week that you can open and use, so direction changes stay cheap.

items.title: Support That Answers
items.body: Monitoring, maintenance and a real response after launch. Shipping is the middle of the project.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.headline: The full spectrum of IT services

items.title: Server Software Solutions
items.body: Backend systems, APIs and data layers engineered for your workload — built to scale and documented well enough to hand over.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence
items.body: AI applied to real operational work: automating the repetitive, surfacing what matters, and supporting faster decisions.

items.title: Brand & Marketing
items.body: Positioning, identity and campaigns grounded in the competitive landscape rather than in taste alone.

items.title: Web Development
items.body: Fast, accessible, search-visible sites and web applications — built to perform on a phone, not just on a designer's laptop.

items.title: Internet of Things (IoT)
items.body: Connected devices, telemetry and provisioning, with the dashboards and platform that make a fleet manageable.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.body: Research, flows and interfaces that people can actually use, delivered as a design system your developers can build from.

design.label: Design and Marketing Services
design.headline: Design & Marketing
design.intro: Our team shares practical insight on building a distinctive brand, websites people trust, and campaigns that actually reach the market. Build a strong image for your business with us.

cards.title: Market research
cards.photo: Desk scene — laptop and monitor showing analytics, natural window light, muted tones.

cards.title: Strategy & positioning
cards.photo: Hands at a wall of sticky notes, workshop in progress, backlit.

cards.title: Identity design
cards.photo: Colour swatch books and printed palette sheets fanned across a dark surface.

cards.title: Campaign launch
cards.photo: Wide shot — team presenting to clients in a bright meeting room. Full-bleed banner crop.

contact.label: Contact us
contact.headline: Let's build something
contact.body: A short email is enough to start. We will come back with questions, a rough shape, and an honest view on whether we are the right fit for the work.

footer.blurb: An IT company delivering server software, cloud, artificial intelligence, web development, IoT and UI/UX design.

notes.photos: The imagery is original generated abstract art in the brand palette. To use real photography instead, overwrite the matching file in assets/img/ (keep the filename) and rebuild; the shot briefs for a future photoshoot are kept on each item's 'photo' field in this file.
notes.content: No invented clients, testimonials or statistics appear anywhere on this site.
